description: List the people in a workspace: members (with role, status, brand access and API access) and pending invites, plus seats in use. API access says whether a teammate can use this workspace's API plan from their own keys and AI apps; owners and admins also see each member's key count, connected AI apps and last use. Needs an API key with the Manage team permission. Any workspace member can list; brand-limited teammates only see brand ids they can access.
name: list_workspace_members
